xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The State of West Bengal enacted “Tax on Entry of goods into Local Areas Act, 2012”. xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Company will be filing further appeal with Hon'ble Supreme Court Challenging the validity of Entry Tax of West Bengal
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: AY 2010-11 - Appeal was pending before Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) which was earlier allowed by Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals). This is related to Disallowance of expenditure u/s 14A. Department’s appeal was dismissed by ITAT vide its Order dated 05-02-2025. The tax impact on the same in Rs.1.15 Crores.

For AY 2018-19 and AY 2020-21 - Appeal were pending before Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) which was earlier allowed by Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals). This is related to Disallowance of expenditure u/s 14A. Department’s appeal was dismissed by ITAT vide its Order dated 24-02-2025. The tax impact on the same in Rs.1.00 Crores.

Appeal was pending before Supreme Court. Issues related to power of granting exemption. The law was amended by prescribed condition of obtaining FORM C & D for exempted entities with retrospective amendment. Department appeal was dismissed by Supreme Court vide its Order dated 12-02-2025. The tax impact on the same in Rs.37.00 Crores.

For the AY 2013-14, Appeal were pending before Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) which was earlier allowed by Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals). This is related to Disallowance of expenditure u/s 14A – Giving Effect Order against Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) Order passed by AO on 26.02.2025. The tax impact on the same in Rs.1.01 Crores.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Department’s appeal was dismissed by ITAT vide its Order which is also reported to Stock exchange on 11th April 2025
